Croatica in Füssen

** Discover the vibrant **Croatica** festival in the charming town of **Füssen**, where Bavarian tradition meets Mediterranean flair. This unique event brings together the best of **Tirol**’s alpine culture and the lively spirit of Croatia. **

When and Where

** The festival takes place annually in the heart of **Füssen**, right by the picturesque **Forgensee** lake. The exact dates vary each year, so keep an eye on the official schedule. **

What Awaits You

** - **Live Music:** Enjoy a mix of **Tiroler** folk tunes and Croatian melodies, from traditional **Schuhplattler** dances to energetic **Klapa** singing. - **Culinary Delights:** Savor authentic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** paired with Croatian specialties such as **Peka** (slow-cooked meat and vegetables) or fresh seafood. - **Crafts & Markets:** Browse handmade goods from Croatian artisans and local **Tiroler** craftsmen, from intricate lacework to wooden carvings. - **Family Fun:** Kids can join in with games, face painting, and even mini dance lessons—because culture is for everyone! **

Why Visit?

** **Füssen** is a gateway to the breathtaking **Alps**, with easy access to **Innsbruck**, **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, and the fairy-tale **Neuschwanstein Castle**. The **Croatica** festival is the perfect way to experience the warmth of two cultures in one unforgettable setting. **

Practical Info

** - **Location:** Festival grounds near **Forgensee**, **Füssen** (Bavaria). - **Admission:** Free entry (some workshops or tastings may require a small fee). - **Transport:** Reachable by car, train (nearby **Füssen** station), or bus. Don’t miss this chance to dance, eat, and celebrate under the **Tiroler** sky with a Croatian twist! **More info here.**
